## LinearKinkConfig #1

Admits a kink at exactly full utilization, so an out of band config deploys.

- **Mutant:** [`1.sol`](1.sol)
- **Caught by:** [`rvIcfGetOrDeployLinearRevertsIffParamsInvalid`](../../specs/IrmConfigFactory/IrmConfigFactory_properties.spec#L276)
- **Reproduce (→ VIOLATED):** `./certora/mutations/run_mutation.sh LinearKinkConfig 1`
- **Run on clean src:** `certoraRun certora/confs/IrmConfigFactory/properties.conf --rule rvIcfGetOrDeployLinearRevertsIffParamsInvalid`

```diff
--- a/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkConfig.sol
+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkConfig.sol
@@ -35,7 +35,7 @@
     /// @notice Validates `kinkParams` and freezes it into immutables.
     constructor(LinearKinkParams memory kinkParams) {
         require(kinkParams.optimalUtilization > 0, ErrorsLib.INVALID_OPTIMAL_UTILIZATION);
-        require(kinkParams.optimalUtilization < WAD, ErrorsLib.INVALID_OPTIMAL_UTILIZATION);
+        require(kinkParams.optimalUtilization <= WAD, ErrorsLib.INVALID_OPTIMAL_UTILIZATION);
         require(
             uint256(kinkParams.baseRate) + kinkParams.slope1 + kinkParams.slope2 <= MAX_BORROW_RATE,
             ErrorsLib.MAX_RATE_EXCEEDED
```

+        require(kinkParams.optimalUtilization >= 0, ErrorsLib.INVALID_OPTIMAL_UTILIZATION);

+++ b/lib/lend-irm/src/linear-kink-irm/LinearKinkConfig.sol
@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@
     /// @inheritdoc ILinearKinkConfig
     function getKinkParams() external view returns (LinearKinkParams memory) {
         return LinearKinkParams({
-            optimalUtilization: OPTIMAL_UTILIZATION, baseRate: BASE_RATE, slope1: SLOPE1, slope2: SLOPE2
+            optimalUtilization: BASE_RATE, baseRate: OPTIMAL_UTILIZATION, slope1: SLOPE1, slope2: SLOPE2
         });
     }
 }
